summary: CodeVault today is a governed, artifact-only geometry subsystem where all Cl(4,1) entities are lifted from 3D layout-identity coordinates: points/spheres/planes write only the 5 grade-1 components (indices 1-5) of the 32-component multivector, rotor candidates write grade-0+grade-2 (indices 0, 6-15), and trivector/4-vector/pseudoscalar slots (16-31) are unused by every builder — verified empirically. The planned Tier-1 structural encoder has clean free real estate in components 16-30 (no collision with any entity kind), but three hard blockers exist: embed_point rejects anything except shape-(3,) input so a new lift function is required; writing any currently-zero component breaks is_null_point (metric diagonal is ±1 everywhere, empirically confirmed: a 0.05 trivector write yields inner=-0.0025) so the invariant must be redefined as a grade-1-projection check; and null_project_point reconstructs from arr[1:4] only, silently erasing structural components on reprojection. The symbol extractor captures none of the seven planned AST features (it emits only kind/name/content from top-level nodes and collapses AsyncFunctionDef into "function"). Governance requires a new representation/geometry-kind in the projection contract, a frame schema decision (v2 node fields vs separate encoder artifact), validator registration, command-authority rows, and staged-acceptance/capability-promotion ledger rows — plus resolving the doctrine tension that CODE_VAULT.md pins coordinates to layout identity "never source content" while structural features are inherently content-derived. A benchmark lane has strong existing patterns to copy (validation_benchmark.py p50/p95/p99 + parity report; code_vault_demo_loop.py proof rows + chain verification + report digest), but N=10k benchmarks are blocked by O(N^2) pure-Python collision detection and the repo-map 500-file bound, so synthetic frame generation is required.
current_state: Coordinates derive only from stable layout identity: path-hash to unit sphere via hash_to_unit_vector (builder_ii/code_vault/digests.py lines 51-59), fixed per-kind radii RADIUS_BY_KIND and parent-relative DEPTH_SCALE placement (builder_ii/code_vault/layout.py lines 10-50); doctrine pinned in docs/CODE_VAULT.md line 5 ('never from source content').

Versor component usage (verified empirically with uv run python against builders): embed_point writes only grade-1 components 1-5 (e1,e2,e3 coords at 1-3, e4=0.5*(x^2-1) at index 4, e5=0.5*(x^2+1) at index 5); scalar index 0 and components 6-31 are zero (builder_ii/code_vault/geometry/builders.py lines 41-51). embed_sphere/embed_plane also write only components 1-5 (lines 61-84). embed_rotor_candidate (product of two grade-1 vectors) occupies grade-0 (index 0) + grade-2 (indices 6-15) (lines 87-93). Grade offsets: g0=0, g1=1-5, g2=6-15, g3=16-25, g4=26-30, g5=31 (builder_ii/code_vault/geometry/cl41.py _GRADE_OFFSETS). Trivectors 16-25, 4-vectors 26-30, pseudoscalar 31 are unused by every current builder.

CGA_INNER_METRIC diagonal is +/-1 for all 32 components with no zero entries (builder_ii/code_vault/geometry/builders.py lines 29-38, verified by execution) — any structural component written into a currently-zero slot participates in recall scoring (backend/pure_numpy.py lines 20-26) and in the self-inner-product used by is_null_point.

embed_point hard-rejects >3 base dimensions: 'if coords.shape != (3,): raise ValueError' (builder_ii/code_vault/geometry/builders.py lines 44-45). null_project_point reconstructs strictly from arr[1:4], discarding all other components (lines 54-58). is_null_point uses full cga_inner(entity, entity) with tol 1e-5 (lines 165-166); empirically, writing 0.05 into trivector index 16 flips is_null_point to False (inner = -0.0025).

Symbol extraction is minimal: extract_python_symbols walks only tree.body top-level nodes, emits {kind, name, content(truncated 8192B)} with MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_FILE=64; ast.AsyncFunctionDef is collapsed to kind 'function' (async flag lost); no arity, nesting depth, cyclomatic estimate, decorator count, class-membership (methods inside classes are never visited), or module-hash projection (builder_ii/code_vault/symbol_extractor.py lines 14-51).

Frame artifact schema: FrameNode has layout_id, layout_digest, content_digest, parent_layout_digest, artifact_kind, center_xyz (exactly 3 fixed_decimal_9 strings enforced), radius, status, subtree_digest — no structural-feature fields; HIERARCHICAL_FRAME_SCHEMA_VERSION=1, COORDINATE_ENCODING='fixed_decimal_9' (builder_ii/code_vault/hierarchy.py lines 27-56, validator lines 254-262).

Projection contract pins dimension=32, dtype=float32, basis=CORE_CL41_BASIS and validates geometry_kind/representation/reproject_policy against frozensets, fail-closed; cga_point_function must use CORE_CGA_POINT3_NULL; sphere/plane/rotor cannot reach 'coherent' (builder_ii/code_vault/projection_contract.py lines 113-201).

Recall backends: protocol fixes matrix (N,32) float32 (builder_ii/code_vault/backend/protocol.py lines 13-51); pure_numpy is canonical (backend/pure_numpy.py); core_rs loads only via explicit=True with governed fallback recorded as backend_requested/backend_used/backend_fallback_reason (backend/core_rs_adapter.py lines 17-83, builder_ii/code_vault/recall.py lines 25-38, 85-107). MAX_TOP_K=32 (recall.py line 20). run_recall rebuilds every candidate point entity in a per-node Python loop on each query (recall.py lines 68-77).

Collision detection is O(N^2) pure Python over all node pairs, report-only (builder_ii/code_vault/layout.py lines 71-99) and runs inside every create_hierarchical_frame call (builder_ii/code_vault/hierarchy.py lines 187-188).

Determinism demo/eval loop pattern exists: in-memory proof rows (replay_identical_frame, sibling_addition_preserves_anchor, content_edit_changes_digest_not_center), fail-closed on any proof failure, chain verification, artifact index, evidence markdown, report_digest, output-dir safety checks, --force deletes only KNOWN_DEMO_ARTIFACT_NAMES (builder_ii/code_vault_demo_loop.py lines 35-45, 103-124, 143-236, 399-510).

A general benchmark+parity pattern already exists elsewhere in the repo: benchmark_validator emits p50/p95/p99 latency records (kind builder_ii.validation_benchmark) and generate_parity_report emits python-vs-rust match/mismatch records (kind builder_ii.validation_parity_report) with artifact_is_authority: false (builder_ii/validation_benchmark.py lines 237-363).

Governance shipping surface is fully enumerated: staged-acceptance ledger table rows per layer (docs/CODE_VAULT_STAGED_ACCEPTANCE.md lines 35-51), capability promotion rows (docs/CAPABILITY_PROMOTION.md lines 90-96), Tier-1 command registry entries for all builder-code-vault subcommands (builder_ii/command_authority.py lines 3550-3560), artifact-kind validator registration in _VALIDATORS (builder_ii/artifact_index_records.py lines 409, 457-460), CLI entry point in pyproject.toml line 58.

Determinism/invariant test proof patterns: byte-identical canonical JSON + frame digest replay, sibling-stability, content-edit-center-stability, rename-moves-position (tests/test_code_vault_hierarchy.py lines 38-125); null-cone invariant and 32xfloat32 shape tests (tests/test_code_vault_cga_builders.py lines 18-27); core_rs vs pure_numpy parity fixture with skipif and atol=1e-6 (tests/test_code_vault_core_rs_adapter.py lines 19-32); grade-sign reversion parametrized tests (tests/test_code_vault_cl41.py).
repo_map scanning is bounded to max_files=500 and 1MB per file (builder_ii/repo_map.py lines 151-152), so real-repo scans cannot produce N=1k/10k frames through the default path.
gaps: No Tier-1 structural encoder exists anywhere: no encoder module, no mention of 'structural encoder', 'arity', 'cyclomatic', or 'nesting depth' in builder_ii/ or docs/ (verified by grep across the repo; only hits are unrelated Rust-validation docs).

symbol_extractor.py extracts none of the seven planned features: no arity, nesting depth, cyclomatic complexity estimate, decorator count, async flag (AsyncFunctionDef is collapsed into 'function' at lines 14-17), class-membership flag (class bodies are never walked — only tree.body, lines 40-50), or module-hash projection.

embed_point cannot host the encoder: it raises on any input that is not shape (3,) (builder_ii/code_vault/geometry/builders.py lines 44-45). A new lift function is required; note Cl(4,1) has exactly 5 grade-1 slots and all are consumed by the conformal embedding, so structural features must live in higher-grade components (free slots: trivectors 16-25, 4-vectors 26-30, pseudoscalar 31 — collision-free vs all current entity kinds; grade-2 slots 6-15 would collide with rotor call-edge candidates).

The null-cone invariant breaks under naive structural writes: is_null_point uses the full multivector self-inner-product (builders.py lines 165-166) and the metric diagonal is nonzero everywhere, so any structural component shifts cga_inner(X,X) (empirically confirmed). The encoder needs an explicit invariant redefinition (grade-1-projection null check) plus contract/test updates in tests/test_code_vault_cga_builders.py.

null_project_point erases structural data: it rebuilds the point from arr[1:4] only (builders.py lines 54-58), so the cga_point_function reproject_policy 'null_project_point' (projection_contract.py lines 165-169) would silently strip encoder output; a structural-aware reproject policy or a do_not_reproject-only contract is needed.

No projection-contract vocabulary for a structural point: GEOMETRY_KINDS/CGA_REPRESENTATIONS frozensets (projection_contract.py lines 55-73) have no structural variant; the fail-closed __post_init__ will reject any new kind until the frozensets, Literal types, and geometry rules are extended.

Frame schema has no home for structural features: FrameNode fields and validate_hierarchical_frame enforce exactly 3 center coords and known fields only (hierarchy.py lines 34-45, 254-262); shipping features in the frame requires either a schema_version bump with optional per-node structural block or a new separate artifact kind registered in builder_ii/artifact_index_records.py _VALIDATORS (lines 457-460).

Doctrine conflict unresolved: docs/CODE_VAULT.md line 5 states coordinates derive 'never from source content', and the demo proof content_edit_changes_digest_not_center (code_vault_demo_loop.py lines 197-234) enforces it; structural features are content-derived, so docs must define versor enrichment as content-derived (analogous to content_digest) while center_xyz stays layout-only, and a new determinism proof (content edit changes structural components but not center) is needed.

No benchmark eval lane for CodeVault: no bench command in builder_ii/cli/code_vault_cli.py (commands are frame/digest/lint/context/recall/validate-*/demo/validate-demo, lines 146-383), no CodeVault latency or parity artifact kind, and no staged-acceptance row for benchmarking (docs/CODE_VAULT_STAGED_ACCEPTANCE.md table ends at TUI inspection row, line 51).

N=10k benchmarking is currently infeasible via existing paths: create_hierarchical_frame always runs O(N^2) pure-Python collision detection (~50M pair distances at 10k nodes; layout.py lines 76-98), repo maps are capped at 500 files (repo_map.py line 151), and run_recall re-embeds all N candidates per query in a Python loop (recall.py lines 68-77). A synthetic frame/matrix generator (following validation_benchmark.generate_mock_artifacts, validation_benchmark.py line 52) and either vectorized or bypassable collision detection are required.

core_rs parity is only proven on a 2-point fixture and is skipped when core_rs is absent (tests/test_code_vault_core_rs_adapter.py lines 19-32); no parity evidence at N=100/1k/10k and no persisted parity artifact for CodeVault recall (the validation_parity_report kind in validation_benchmark.py line 297 covers validators, not recall scoring).
risks: Null-cone invariant redefinition is the highest-risk change: relaxing is_null_point to a grade-1 projection check weakens the strongest existing geometric proof (tests/test_code_vault_cga_builders.py line 25); if done carelessly it also invalidates the PR3 staged-acceptance boundary ('null-cone invariant tested', docs/CODE_VAULT_STAGED_ACCEPTANCE.md line 39) without a ledger update.

Feature-scale contamination of recall scores: CGA_INNER_METRIC weights every component +/-1, so raw counts (arity 30, cyclomatic 25) written into components 16-30 would dominate the unit-scale conformal point terms in score_inner_product; without bounded, versioned normalization the Tier-1 encoder changes recall rankings unpredictably and non-comparably across encoder versions.

float32 replay stability: recall scores are serialized at 9 decimal places (recall.py line 83) but float32 carries ~7 significant digits; adding more nonzero components increases accumulation-order sensitivity, and core_rs parity is only asserted at atol=1e-6 — a byte-stable 'replay-stable results artifact' must hash only rank order plus quantized scores, or determinism claims will flake across platforms/BLAS builds.

Governance doctrine drift: encoding content-derived features into the versor is the first content-to-geometry coupling in CodeVault; without an explicit doc amendment and new determinism proof, the change silently contradicts docs/CODE_VAULT.md line 5 and the content_edit_changes_digest_not_center proof, undermining the staged-acceptance audit trail.

Grade-2 slot collision: if structural features are placed in bivector slots 6-15 for convenience, they collide with rotor call-edge candidates (embed_rotor_candidate output), corrupting rotor_similarity comparisons; trivector/4-vector slots are the only collision-free region.

Benchmark honesty risk: latency numbers are inherently non-replayable; if p50/p95/p99 values are folded into the report_digest the same way demo proofs are, validate-bench replays will fail — the report schema must separate deterministic sections (encoder digests, parity counts) from measurement sections, following how code_vault_demo_loop keeps created_at outside proof rows.

O(N^2) collision detection may tempt an unsound shortcut: skipping collision detection only in bench mode creates a code path where benchmarked frame-creation latency does not represent production frame creation, overstating throughput; the choice (vectorize vs report-and-flag) must be recorded in the bench artifact.

Schema-version bump blast radius: HIERARCHICAL_FRAME_KIND validators are consumed by artifact_index_records, chain verification, prepare-package, workflow spine, ConventionKernel, and the TUI (docs/CODE_VAULT_STAGED_ACCEPTANCE.md lines 44-51); a v2 frame that older validators reject breaks the whole platform spine unless the structural block is additive-optional under schema_version 1 semantics or dual-version validation is added.
